meta.title: Changelog - Latest AvifKit Updates
meta.description: See the latest AvifKit improvements, fixes, and platform updates.

hero.title: Changelog
hero.subtitle: A clear record of the improvements, fixes, and behind-the-scenes work that keep AvifKit fast and reliable.

releases.title: More reliable language routing
releases.summary: Default and localized URLs now resolve consistently across direct visits and static hosting.

changes.text: Prevented default English pages from returning an incorrect 404 response.
Aligned localized routing and redirect rules for more reliable direct links.
Expanded the SEO audit to catch default-language routing regressions.

releases.title: Cleaner error handling
releases.summary: Navigation failures are handled more predictably, with cleaner deployment output behind the scenes.

changes.text: Corrected 404 handling for missing pages and direct navigation.
Removed generated Cloudflare cache files from source control.

releases.title: Smoother static deployments
releases.summary: A focused reliability pass improved asset delivery and localized static builds.

changes.text: Restored reliable logo delivery through the static redirect configuration.
Resolved export-time build failures across localized pages.
Updated repository ignore rules to keep generated deployment files out of commits.

releases.title: Cloudflare edge readiness
releases.summary: AvifKit's application and content pipeline were prepared for a more dependable edge deployment.

changes.text: Adjusted application routes and blog content discovery for edge-compatible static output.
Added Cloudflare Pages and Wrangler deployment configuration.
Standardized the pnpm workspace and lockfile setup for reproducible builds.

releases.title: A clearer visual system
releases.summary: The converter, viewer, blog, and legal pages received a site-wide interface refresh.

changes.text: Refined typography, spacing, controls, and content hierarchy across the site.
Updated converter feedback and comparison components for clearer scanning.
Improved the error section so conversion problems are easier to understand.

releases.title: AvifKit's first release
releases.summary: AvifKit launched as a private, browser-based toolkit for converting AVIF images without server uploads.

changes.text: Added local AVIF conversion to JPG, PNG, and WebP directly in the browser.
Launched localized conversion pages in English, Japanese, Spanish, and French.
Published the first practical guides for opening, converting, and working with AVIF files.
